plans.idea: Editorial left-aligned column: one tall text block takes most of the story height so the headline and steps get large type, with a left-aligned pill CTA on the same left edge just below it and the legal line pinned at the foot.

Top-down story with a full-width action bar: the text block starts lower, leaving air under the decorative circle, and finishes into a wide full-width CTA at thumb height so the button reads as the clear end of the reading path.

Inset centred column: a narrower text block stays inside a generous gutter for comfortable line lengths, with the CTA and legal centred on the same axis below it, giving a calm, symmetrical poster for the tall format.
